_comment: Recorded baseline for the AgentFuse eval. CI asserts we never fall below these. A floor, not an achievement. The generated suite (536 scenarios) is the statistically meaningful one; the 16 hand-written cases are named regression cases. Recovery metrics added 2026-08-12 - before that, AgentFuse's central claim ('it steers the agent back') was completely unmeasured.
config_note: drift_threshold default lowered 0.45 -> 0.20 on 2026-08-12 based on the threshold sweep: F1 66.0->73.3, FPR 39.0->10.8, premature trips 54->0, at a cost of 6.4 points of recall. | LoopDetector rewritten 2026-08-12 to require an identical RESULT, not just an identical call: FPR 11.8%->4.9%, precision 82.5%->92.0%, F1 72.2%->75.7%, recall unchanged. Call-only fallback at 2x threshold still catches loops whose output varies cosmetically. | NoProgressDetector rewritten 2026-08-12: the old one incremented its stall counter ONLY on a repeated state hash, but a genuine stall emits no state updates at all, so the trip condition was unreachable - it required evidence of state changes to detect their absence. Now counts weighted actions since the last genuine advance. recall 64.3->89.2, F1 75.7->91.5, progress family 0%->100%, FPR unchanged at 4.9%.

known_weak_families.attribution: 87% not 99%: semantic-variant loops are now caught by the PROGRESS detector as a backstop rather than by LOOP, so the diagnosis is imperfect and the steering says 'check your assumptions' instead of 'stop repeating this tool'. Accepted deliberately - catching them with a blunt diagnosis beats missing them entirely (they were 0% before). Fix: teach LoopDetector to normalise arguments, which restores attribution without costing recall.
known_weak_families.drift: 79% recall - gradual drift still overlaps the paraphrase band lexically.

significance.note: F1 must significantly exceed a rate-matched random control (p < 0.05).

economics_note: 'tokens saved' is WASTE AVOIDED (what the doomed run would have burned after the halt), not net benefit including completing the task. The recovered path's own cost is charged to tokens_spent. Treat ROI as an upper bound on the real economic case.
